delay_fit.method: Tag-only symmetric TX/RX adjustment. A one-tick reduction on both tag delays increases ToF by approximately one tick. Use the baseline median and nearest integer tick. Validate on a separate session.
delay_fit.scope: Trial geometry only. Reported sample standard deviation is repeatability metadata, not absolute uncertainty.

source: Local DW1000 TX_TIME.actual and RX_TIME.hw; RX_RAWST is preserved as diagnostic data.
math: r1=AR-AP, d1=TR-TP, r2=TF-TR, d2=AF-AR, each mod 2^40. ToF=(r1*r2-d1*d2)/(r1+d1+r2+d2).
